meta.requirement: Explore Whispering Woods (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Urgent Help
start.text:
''The sound reaches you before the scene does, a sharp crack of wood on steel, followed by a shout cut short.''

''You push through a curtain of pines and stop.''

''Three adventurers are backed against a mossy boulder, weapons raised. One of them, a young woman in a torn red scarf, clutches her sword arm. Another blinks blood from a cut above his eye. The third, taller, gripping a spear, is the only one who still looks like he can fight.''

''Two hilichurls stalk the perimeter in slow, patient circles. Clubs dragging. They are in no rush. They know the numbers.''

Adventurer: ''through gritted teeth'' Hold the line. Just... hold the line.''

stepintoclear.text:
''You step through the treeline. One of the hilichurls freezes mid-stride. The other tilts its mask.''

''The tall adventurer with the spear spots you first.''

Ryne: Traveller! ''hisses'' Get out of here, this is not—

''The nearer hilichurl turns toward you fully. It has found a new target.''

Ryne: ''through clenched jaw'' ...Or stay. Your choice.

hwmny.text:
Ryne: Two left. There were four when they hit us near the last waypoint. ''glances at the woman in the scarf'' Sora caught one in the shoulder before we drove the first pair off. She can still fight, but not for long.

''He shifts his grip on the spear.''

Ryne: We need someone to split their focus. If they're both watching you, we can flank. That's all I'm asking.

choices.label: I'll draw them off. Get behind me

I_will_draw_them_off_Get_behind_me.text:
''Ryne gives one short, tight nod. The three of them start shifting back, giving ground toward the tree line, moving slowly so as not to trigger a charge.''

Ryne: ''barely audible, still watching the hilichurls'' Once we're clear, they'll come for you. Both of them. Don't wait for them to make the first move.

''The adventurers slip behind you. The clearing narrows. Just you, and two hilichurls who have locked every bit of their attention on the one person still standing between them and what they were hunting.''

''One of them raises its club.''

''You grip your weapon.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the two Hilichurls attacking the adventurers in the Whispering Woods

continues.label: Do /rpg and click on Assist Adventurers. Defeat 2 [[Hilichurl]]s

whats_in_it.text:
''Ryne stares at you for exactly one second.''

Ryne: ...Right. ''exhales'' Okay. We pool what we've got. Everything in the group purse, plus supplies. It's a fair offer.

''The closer hilichurl has stopped circling. Both of them are watching you now. Calculating.''

Ryne: ''quietly'' Tick tock, traveller.

kill_hili.text:
''The clearing is quiet.''

''Not the held-breath quiet of before, but the wide, settling kind that comes after a storm. The hilichurls lie still. Somewhere in the pines, a bird starts singing again.''

''Heavy footsteps behind you. Ryne lowers his spear slowly as he looks at what you have done.''

Ryne: ''a little hoarse'' ...Traveller.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Talk with the adventurers in the Whispering Woods

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Talk to the Adventurers

talk_to_adv.text:
''Sora has settled onto the boulder now, pale but steady. Kian, the one who had blood in his eyes, has wiped most of it away. He hands Ryne a waterskin without being asked.''

Ryne: ''clears his throat'' Right. I owe you a name, at least. Ryne. ''nods toward the others'' Sora. Kian.

''Sora raises one finger from her injured arm in a small wave. Kian looks at you directly, which appears to be his version of a greeting.''

how_bad_is_should.text:
Sora: ''lightly'' Oh, it's fine. I've had worse.

Kian: She has not.

Sora: ''glares at him, then can't quite help a tired laugh'' He does that. Constantly. ''to you'' It's bad. We need to get back to camp and get it looked at properly.

Ryne: We will. ''reaches into his pack'' But first.

dont_hve_to.text:
Ryne: ''cutting you off'' We said what we said.

''He counts coin from the group's shared purse. Kian, without being asked, adds something from his own pocket. Sora would too, probably, if she could reach hers.''

Ryne: We've been out here three weeks mapping the deep woods for the Adventurers' Guild. ''quietly'' You might have just kept that from ending in a ditch.

choices.label: Stay out of the deep woods next time

whats_worth.text:
Ryne: ''a little more animated despite everything'' Ruins, mostly. Old ones. Older than the Statues, maybe. Kian thinks the stonework doesn't match anything in the Guild's catalogues.

Kian: ''quietly'' The foundations run deeper than they should. Whatever they were built for, it was not shelter. It was not defense. We do not know what it was.

''A beat.''

Sora: ''conspiratorially, to you'' He's been saying that for three weeks. In exactly that tone. It is, by a large margin, the most excited we have ever seen him.

''Kian does not deny it.''

Heroes_Aided.title: Heroes Aided
Heroes_Aided.text:
Ryne: ''tired smile'' We'll try harder next time.

''He claps a hand on your shoulder once, briefly, then turns to help Sora up. Kian is already gathering their packs.''

''They move back through the trees slowly, for Sora's sake. Ryne is the last to disappear into the pines.''

Ryne: ''over his shoulder'' Hey. Thank you. Really.

''Then the forest closes behind them.''

''You stand alone in the clearing for a moment. The broken clubs are still on the ground. The mossy boulder is just a boulder again. Somewhere above the canopy, the afternoon light is already tilting toward evening.''

''You move on.''
